content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media software and outsourced operations for operators; no government defense or infrastructure engineering business."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Government engineering, technical and mission support services for defense, intelligence and energy agencies, matching Parsons' contract-based service model."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Consulting, cybersecurity and engineering services sold mainly to defense, intelligence and civilian federal agencies, closely matching Parsons."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells network security hardware and subscriptions through channel partners; a product business, not government engineering services."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and program management for government, transportation, water and defense clients, closely matching Parsons' services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"IP communications hardware and software for telecom carriers; different products and customers from Parsons' government work."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Engineering and consulting for government water, environment and infrastructure clients, overlapping Parsons' infrastructure design and program management."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures aircraft, helicopters and vehicles; a hardware manufacturer rather than an engineering and technology services provider."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Makes network test instruments and optical components; equipment manufacturing with different products from Parsons' services and software."}]}
